integrity: Exact formulas and parity reconfiguration proved by direct structural classification; finite graph-level enumeration through n=9 is corroborative, not an infinite certificate. Bibliographic priority is subject to independent checking.
scientific_limitations: One-subdivisions S(K_n), n >= 3; one-edge replacement between minimum-cardinality inclusion-maximal induced matchings. No claims for nonminimum layers or for general graph classes. Priority comparisons may miss unindexed equivalent results.
title: A parity transition for optimal maximal induced-matching reconfiguration in subdivided cliques
